item.title: igorbarinov/awesome-bitcoin Dec 9th - Dec 15th, 2019
item.description:
Read

  • A Gentle Introduction to Bitcoin Core Development
  • btcinformation.org / Developer Documentation - Find useful resources, guides and reference material for developers.
  • Grokking Bitcoin - An in-depth technical book with rich illustrations.
  • Elliptic Curve Cryptography A Gentle Introduction.
  • Bitcoin Programming with BitcoinJS and Bitcoin Core CLIstars119.
  • Bitcoin Protocol Development Curriculum - Chaincode Labsstars360.
  • Lightning Network Protocol Development Curriculum - Chaincode Labsstars251.

    • Course

  • Bitcoin & Cryptocurrency.

    • Additional Resources

  • @lopp / Bitcoin Developers - Software developers who have experience working on Bitcoin implementations or applications.
  • @lopp / Lightning Developers - Software developers with experience working on LN implementations / applications.
  • A brief history of Bitcoin development...
  • Practical Bitcoin Info - Google Sheets.

    • Utilities

  • BitKey - Live USB for airgapped transactions and Bitcoin swiss army knife.
  • Pycoinstars1.2k - Python-based Bitcoin and alt-coin utility library.
  • bxstars466 - Bitcoin Command Line Tool.
  • txwatcherstars41 - A little Python utility that lets you monitor Bitcoin addresses through Blockchain Websocket API and perform custom callbacks.
  • hellobitcoinstars244 - A collection of simple programs which can generate bitcoin wallets, create and sign transactions, and send transactions over the bitcoin network.
  • HD Wallet Scannerstars12 - Find all used addresses in your Bitcoin HD wallets bypassing gap limits.

    • Blockchain API and Web services

  • Cashier-BTCstars234 - Self-hosted payment gateway.
  • Chainradar APIstars2 - Blockchain Explorer API for Chainradar.

    • Blockchain Explorers

  • Bitkit - Real time transaction updates.

    • JavaScript Libraries

  • bcoinstars2.6k - Javascript bitcoin library for node.js and browsers.

    • Python Libraries

  • btctxstorestars9 - Simple library to store/retrieve information in bitcoin transactions using OP_RETURN.
  • pybitcointoolsstars1.2k - Python library for Bitcoin signatures and transactions from Vitalik Buterin. Project discontinued.
  • pycoinstars1.2k - Python library for Bitcoin keys, signatures, transactions. Includes full VM implementation and tools for manipulating keys (ku) and transactions (tx).

    • Java Libraries

  • XChangestars3.3k - Library that provides a simple and consistent API for interacting with 50+ Bitcoin currency exchanges.

    • Scala libraries

  • Bitcoin-S - Scala/JVM toolkit for Bitcoin applications, includes Bitcoin data structures, transaction signing, strongly typed bitcoind/Eclair RPC clients, and more.

    • .Net Libraries

  • BitcoinLibstars366 - The most complete, up-to-date, battle-tested .net Library and RPC Wrapper for Bitcoin and Altcoins in C#.
  • QBitNinjastars65 - An Open Source and powerful blockchain API.

    • Playgrounds

  • Bitcoin IDEstars171 - Bitcoin Script for dummies.
  • blockchain-demostars4k - A web-based demonstration of blockchain concepts.
  • Bitcoin Script Debuggerstars48 - Visualize Bitcoin script execution for real transactions.

    • Blockchain dump

  • WebBTC - These are postgres database dumps of the bitcoin-ruby-blockchain database generated by webbtc.com.
  • BitcoinDatabaseGeneratorstars108 - A high performance data transfer tool that can be used to copy data from Bitcoin Core blockchain files to a SQL Server database.
  • Blockparser+SQLstars60 - Fast, quick and dirty bitcoin blockchain parser.
  • BitcoinABEstars926 - Abe: block browser for Bitcoin and similar currencies.
  • NBitcoin.Indexerstars27 - Scalable and fault-tolerant block chain indexer for Azure cloud platform.
  • Blockchain2Graphstars138 - Graph Database Builder.

    • Full nodes

  • Bitcoin-ruby-nodestars26 - bitcoin node based on bitcoin-ruby-blockchain.
  • Bitcore Nodestars351 - bitcoind linked to node.js by BitPay.
  • Bitcorestars4.2k - Formerly just a Nodejs library, now a full node.
